question: Return the average number of units sold in millions among games played by players who have the position Guard.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "games" AS SELECT "game_id" AS "game_id", "title" AS "title", "units_sold_millions" AS "units_sold_millions" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "players" AS SELECT "player_id" AS "player_id", "position" AS "position" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "player_game_links" AS SELECT CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS player_id, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS game_id WHERE 1=0
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE games AS SELECT game_id, title, units_sold_millions, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns FROM games
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE players AS SELECT player_id, position, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns FROM players
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE player_game_links AS SELECT player_id, game_id, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns FROM player_game_links
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "games" AS SELECT game_id, title, units_sold_millions, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns FROM games
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "players" AS SELECT player_id, position, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns FROM players
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "player_game_links" AS SELECT player_id, game_id, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns FROM player_game_links

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH guards AS (
    SELECT player_id
    FROM players
    WHERE LOWER(position) LIKE '%guard%'
), guard_games AS (
    SELECT l.game_id
    FROM player_game_links l
    JOIN guards g ON l.player_id = g.player_id
), games_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT game_id
    FROM guard_games
)
SELECT
    CAST(AVG(g.units_sold_millions) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_units_sold_millions
FROM games g
JOIN games_dedup d ON g.game_id = d.game_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH norm_players AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           LOWER(TRIM(position)) AS pos
    FROM players
), guards AS (
    SELECT player_id
    FROM norm_players
    WHERE pos LIKE '%guard%'
       OR pos = 'g'
       OR pos LIKE 'pg%'
       OR pos LIKE '% pg%'
       OR pos LIKE 'sg%'
       OR pos LIKE '% sg%'
), guard_games AS (
    SELECT l.game_id
    FROM player_game_links l
    JOIN guards g ON l.player_id = g.player_id
), games_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM guard_games
)
SELECT CAST(AVG(g.units_sold_millions) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_units_sold_millions
FROM games g
JOIN games_dedup d ON g.game_id = d.game_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH norm_players AS (
    SELECT player_id, LOWER(TRIM(position)) AS pos FROM players
), guards AS (
    SELECT player_id FROM norm_players
    WHERE pos LIKE '%guard%'
       OR pos = 'g'
       OR pos LIKE 'pg%'
       OR pos LIKE '% pg%'
       OR pos LIKE 'sg%'
       OR pos LIKE '% sg%'
), guard_games AS (
    SELECT l.game_id FROM player_game_links l JOIN guards g ON l.player_id = g.player_id
), agg AS (
    SELECT AVG(g.units_sold_millions) AS avg_units_sold_millions
    FROM games g
    WHERE g.game_id IN (SELECT game_id FROM guard_games)
)
SELECT CAST(a.avg_units_sold_millions AS DOUBLE) AS avg_units_sold_millions,
       CASE WHEN a.avg_units_sold_millions IS NULL THEN 'No games linked to players with Guard position were found' ELSE NULL END AS note
FROM agg a

query = """

WITH norm_players AS (
    SELECT player_id, LOWER(TRIM(position)) AS pos FROM players
), guards AS (
    SELECT player_id FROM norm_players
    WHERE pos LIKE '%guard%'
       OR pos = 'g'
       OR pos LIKE 'pg%'
       OR pos LIKE '% pg%'
       OR pos LIKE 'sg%'
       OR pos LIKE '% sg%'
), guard_games AS (
    SELECT l.game_id FROM player_game_links l JOIN guards g ON l.player_id = g.player_id
), agg AS (
    SELECT AVG(g.units_sold_millions) AS avg_units_sold_millions
    FROM games g
    WHERE g.game_id IN (SELECT game_id FROM guard_games)
)
SELECT CAST(a.avg_units_sold_millions AS DOUBLE) AS avg_units_sold_millions,
       CASE WHEN a.avg_units_sold_millions IS NULL THEN 'No games linked to players with Guard position were found' ELSE NULL END AS note
FROM agg a
